bio.text: Gonzalo Duran is the Conservative Party candidate for New York's 15th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Democrat Ritchie Torres is also running.

According to Ballotpedia, he was born in New York City, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2003 to 2011, graduated from DeWitt Clinton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Fordham University in 2014.

PoliticsNY described him in February 2026 as a military veteran and founder of Devil Dog USA, an organization that supports veterans transitioning back to civilian life, and Ballotpedia lists him as vice chairman of the Bronx Conservative Party.

sources.title: Conservative party's Gonzalo Duran enters NY-15 race, vows to challenge socialism
